scripts.launch_sd.bat: Starts SD.Next engine with CUDA, xformers and API enabled. (SUPER FAST)
scripts.gen_darkmatter.py: Generates high-definition portraits (1024x1536) using Hires Fix. High fidelity.
scripts.generate_dataset.py: Automated dataset generation for new characters. Now using 768x768 for premium training.
scripts.train_models.bat: Local LoRA training script. Optimzed for bf16 and 16GB VRAM. No longer requires Cloud/AMD workarounds.
scripts.gen_morgana.py: Standard SFW character test. Needs similar resolution upgrade.

recommendations: Use Hires Fix with 0.5-0.6 denoising for maximum realism.
Training can now be done locally with batch sizes of 4-8.
Resolution 768x768 is the sweet spot for SD1.5 training on this card.
